entities.name: Timoxenus of Achaia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Timoxenos was a general in Ancient Greece, who served for three or four terms as strategos of the Achaean League between 226 and 215 BC. He was considered a supporter of Aratus of Sicyon.
